description: Stems all flowering, solitary, 10–35(–40 cm) cm high; yellowish, brownish or reddish to maroon; often red striped. Flowers solitary; buds ellipsoid. Calyx 2.5–3.5 cm long, the tip erect to recurved; purplish, pinkish, rarely whitish; often glossy. Corolla ca 2–3(–4) cm long; ca 1.5–2 cm of tube exserted beyond calyx, exserted portion of tube weakly curved or ± straight, usually purplish to maroon on outside, occasionally whitish; lower portion of concealed part of tube strongly flexed, often ± geniculate, forming a narrow throat above the ovary; lobes ca 2 mm long, rounded, not denticulate, little-spreading; usually purplish to maroon on both surfaces, occasionally whitish externally and purple to maroon on the interior face; glossy externally. Stamens included, attached ± at point of inflexion of corolla tube; point of attachment hairless. Style yellow or whitish-pink, curved; stigma yellow or whitish-pink, included. Capsule ca 2.5 cm, dehiscent by rotting of the walls.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aeginetia indica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 144. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stems all flowering, clustered or solitary, usually branched, ≤ 10 cm high, usually reddish. Flowers usually clustered, occasionally solitary; buds ellipsoid. Calyx ca 4 cm long, yellowish, apex apiculate and sometimes somewhat recurved, often glossy. Corolla ca 5–7 cm long; ca 2.5–3 cm of tube exserted beyond calyx, tube weakly curved throughout, tube white, uppermost section of exposed part of tube and lobes purplish, throat and centre of lower lip yellow; lobes ca 5 mm long, rounded or deltoid, spreading, the outer margins upcurved, sometimes minutely denticulate. Stamens included, attached ± ⅔ of way down corolla-tube; point of attachment with a distinct tuft of hairs, these effectively closing the throat of the corolla tube. Style curved; stigma included. Capsule dehiscent by rotting of the walls.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Aeginetia pedunculata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 144. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Rhizome branched. Stem up to 2.5 m high. Leaves with a short petiole; lamina dark green with purple tones, obovate to lanceolate up to 50 by 20 cm. Flowers 1–2 in each cincinnus; bracts green, ovate, 6–9 mm long. Outer tepals lanceolate ca 15 mm; inner tepals joined a base to a 15 mm long, yellow to orange tube, lobes lanceolate, ca 4 cm, yellow or red. Outer staminodes ca 5 by 1 cm; labellum red, often with yellow spots ca 5 cm; stamen lanceolate ca 4.5 cm. Ovary green, ca 5 mm in diam.; style red and yellowish-orange, ca 6 cm. Capsule broadly ovoid 1.5–2 cm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Canna indica. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 91. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: This name is given to a group of hybrids of unknown origin. They are widely cultivated in the tropics. All floral parts are larger and staminodes broader than in Canna indica. Flower colour varies from red to pink and yellow and in some cultivars spotted, streaked or variegated.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Canna x generalis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 93. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tree, 3–4 m high; stem usually unbranched, with large prominent leaf-scars; wood soft and succulent. Leaves ovate or orbicular in outline, up to ca 75 cm long and broad, deeply palmately divided into 3–7 lobes, lobes pinnatifid, with toothed margin, lobe-apex acute to acuminate; petiole 40–100 cm long, 1–3 cm in diam. Flowers fragrant. Staminate flowers in panicles, up to 40(–100) cm long, pendulous; sessile, 3–6 by 1.5–2 cm; calyx ca 2 mm long, 5-lobed, acute; corolla creamy yellow, tube 2.5–3(–6) cm long, lobes 5, twisted in bud, ca 1 by 1.5 cm; filaments ca 1.5 mm long; anthers 1.5–2 mm long, papillose, 2-celled, basifixed, dehiscing longitudinally. Pistillate flowers in few-flowered inflorescences or solitary with a staminate flower on either sides; peduncle 1-2 cm long; bracts fleshy, leaf-like, 1–2 cm long, caducous; calyx lobes oblong, 5–8 mm long, acute, green and fleshy; petals lanceolate, 5–6.5 by 0.8–1.5 cm, obtuse; ovary 3.5–4 by 1.5–1.8 cm; stigma lobes fimbriate, ca 6 mm long. Fruit ellipsoid, cylindrical, narrowly obovoid or pyriform, 20–30 by 8–15 cm, yellow or orange when maturity; thick yellow, orange or red pulp. Seeds ellipsoid, ca 2 mm in diam., black, wrinkled.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carica papaya. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 95. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Herb up to 1 m. Stems thin, puberulous (almost glabrous towards apex), rooting at the nodes. Leaves delicate, asymmetric, ovate oblong to lanceolate, 4–16 by 3–9 cm, apex acuminate to long cuspidate, puberulous on both sides, dentate crenulate, petiole 2–5 cm long. Inflorescences corymbs densely flowered, 4–5 cm across, with two reduced, spathulate leaves at base; peduncles up to 2 cm. Flowers cream coloured, in pairs; pedicels 1–2 mm, without bracteoles. Calyx tube puberulous, ca 1 mm, lobes 4(–5) linear, puberulous. Corolla puberulous outside, inside glabrous, ca 6 mm, lobes 4, rounded, 1–2 mm. Disc cylindric, low with crenate margin. Stamens 2; filaments ca 1 mm, inserted in the middle of the tube; anthers twice as long. Style filiform, ca 5 mm long. Capsule pyramidal, ca 3 mm by 7 mm, 4 lobed, dehiscing by 2 valves. Seeds ca 1 mm long, black, reticulate.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Carlemannia tetragona. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 99. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Small parasitic fleshy herbs (≤ 10 cm); stems very short or absent; pedicels usually very short. Buds covered in copious translucent, tasteless slime when immature. Flowers relatively large. Calyx yellowish or whitish, sometimes dark purple, tubular, ca 3 cm, 3-toothed (reportedly up to 5-toothed), teeth ca 3–6 mm long. Corolla long (ca 5–7 cm) tubular, campanulate, somewhat curved when fresh, 5-lobed; tube dirty white outside, sometimes tinged with purple; lobes ca 1 cm, bluish to violet with a yellow patch on the middle of the lower lip stretching down the interior of the tube. Stamens: filaments yellow; point of attachment with a distinct tuft of hairs, these effectively closing the throat of the corolla tube; 1 pair often prominently spurred; spur with an obvious conical projection at the tip. Style long. Capsule bivalved.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Christisonia siamensis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 146. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Erect shrub with unbranced or spacely branched stems up to 3 m in diam., up to 3 cm. Leaves with dilated base, petiole short or up to several cm, green or variegated, in some cultivars deep purple or with coloured stripes or spots, oblong-lanceolate to narrowly oblong, 20–60 cm long including petiole; lamina 3–10 cm wide, apex acuminate, midvein raised on lower side. Inflorescence an erect, multi-flowered, green to purple panicle, 30–70 cm long with bracts at base of the spreading branches. Flowers 6–9 mm in diam., shortly petiolate, subtended by few, minute bracts. Perianth segments linear, various shades of pink, yellow or violet; tube 5–7 mm; lobes as long as tube. Stamens slightly shorter than perianth, inserted in the throat of the perianth. Ovary with style as long as perianth or slightly shorter. Capsule shining, reddish green. Seeds usually many, black, shining.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Cordyline fruticosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 122. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stem 1–2(–3) m, thickened at base, covered by glabrous sheaths, only bearing leaf blades in the apical part, erect when young, later bend over and branching in upper part; sheaths glabrous. Leaf blade to 20–25 by 6–7 cm, cuneate at base, acuminate at apex, glabrous on both sides. Inflorescence on a separate shoot from the rhizome; peduncle short, covered by pubescent, overlapping sheaths, ± globose, ca 8 cm in diam. Bracts glabrous, red, 2–3.5 cm by ca 2.5 cm with rounded apex ending in a yellowish, spine-like tip, 2–3 mm, each subtending 1 flower. Bracteole ca 2 cm, scale-like, falcate, ca 4 mm broad. Flower: calyx yellow with red margin, tube ca 3 cm including ovary, glabrous, ca 5 mm, 3-dentate, each tooth ending in a short spine. Corolla tube ca 3.5 cm long, glabrous, lobes yellowish-orange, glabrous, lateral ones 4.5 by 2 cm, apiculatate, glabrous, median one ca 5.5 cm. Labellum red, glabrous with undulate margin, inside towards the throat pale reddish with scattered ampulliform hairs. Filament petaloid, ca 4 cm long, 1 cm broad at base, 1.5 in the middle, glabrous except at apex which is covered by stiff hairs along the margin; anther ca 1 cm long. Ovary glabrous, 15–18 by 7–10 mm. Fruit unknown.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Costus dhaninivatii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 102. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stem to about 3 m, thickend at base, covered by glabrous or pubescent sheaths, only bearing leaf blades in the apical part, erect when young, later bend over and branching in upper part. Leaf blade to 30 by 10 cm, widest above the middle, unequally cuneate at base, acuminate at apex, glabrous or pubescent beneath. Inflorescence on a separate shoot from the rhizome; peduncle 2–10(–20) cm, covered by pubescent, overlapping sheaths, ± globose, 5–9 cm in diam. Bracts red, 2–3.5 by ca 2.5 cm with rounded apex ending in a yellowish, spine-like tip, 2–3 mm, outer surface ± covered by stiff hairs, each subtending 1 flower. Bracteoles as long as bracts but much narrower, at base embracing the ovary. Flower: calyx tube 3–4 cm including ovary, pubescent as the bracts, lobes red, 6–8 mm, ending in a stout spine. Corolla tube shorter than calyx, lobes ca 3.5 by 2 cm, apiculatate, pubescent outside, pink to deep red. Labellum red or orange to yellow with long hairs along the margin, inside towards the throat whitish or yellowish hairy. Stamen puberulous, same colour as labellum or paler. Ovary appressed pubescent. Capsule enclosed by the bracts.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Costus globosus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 102. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stem 1–2 m, erect, usually not spirally curved, lower half of stem covered by blade-less sheaths, upper half leafy; sheath ca 4 cm, green, densely puberulous when young later glabrescent; petiole 5–10 mm. Leaf blade elliptic, to lanceolate-oblong, 20–40 by 6–15 cm, base rounded to cordate, apex acute to acuminate, upper side glabrescent, lower side sparsely to densely villous. Inflorescence terminal to about 10 cm long, 5–7 cm wide on a short, usually curved peduncle. Bracts 12–15 mm long, each subtending 1 flower, ovate, acute, green often flushed with red, with a narrow red, fleshy protuberance up to 5 mm long below the apex, glabrous to hairy, when old breaking into fibres. Bracteoles ca 10 mm, ovate, acute with ciliate margin. Flower: calyx green turning red, much longer than bract, up to 3 cm, with 3 reddish, unequal teeth, split to base on one side. Corolla tube shorter than calyx, lobes 3–5 by 2.5—3 cm, white or pinkish. Labellum 69 cm across, white to pinkish with a median yellowish band. Stamen petaloid, oblong ca 5 by 1.2 cm, filament ca 12 mm broad. Ovary flattened, ca 9 mm broad. Capsule ellipsoid, ca 2.4 cm long, hirsute crowned by the persistent calyx.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Costus lacerus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 104. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Stem 1–3 m, branching with age in upper part, often spirally curved, lower half of stem covered by blade-less sheaths, upper half leafy, sheath ca 4 cm, green flushed with purple, silky hairy, at margin with longer hairs. Leaf blade oblanceolate-acuminate, up to 23 by 6 cm, widest above the middle, base rounded, upper side glabrous to appressed hairy, lower side from almost glabrous to densely sericeous; petiole 5–7 mm, appressed hairy. Inflorescence to about 10 cm long, 5-6 cm broad on a short, usually curved peduncle. Bracts 12–15 mm long, each subtending 1 flower, ovate, acute, green often flushed with red, with a narrow red fleshy protuberance up to 5 mm long, below apex glabrous to hairy. Bracteoles ca 10 mm, acute with ciliate margin. Flower: calyx green turning red, much longer than bract, up to 2.2 cm including the ovary, with 3 reddish, unequal teeth. Corolla tube shorter than calyx, lobes 3–5 cm, white or pinkish. Labellum 5.5–7.5 cm across, white with a median yellowish band with long yellow hairs. Stamen ca 2.5 cm long; filament when flattened 10–12 mm broad, yellow at apex, pubescent. Ovary flattened, ca 9 mm broad. Capsule red.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Costus speciosus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 106. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Perennial herb up to 1 m. Leaves linear-lanceolate, in rosette and along the stem, with sheathing base, 50–80 cm long, 10–30 cm broad. Inflorescence longer than leaves, with few branches; pedicels 5–15 mm. Tepals various shades of blue, green to yellowish, 5–7 mm long. Stamens about half as long as tepals. Ovary green with few ovules per locule. Fruit shining blue, ca 10 mm long. Seeds globose, 3–4 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Dianella ensifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 114. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Widely branched plant, 3–5 m high. Sheath up to 18 cm long; green, glabrous; pulvinus 1–2 cm long, green, glabrous; lamina ovate-elliptic, acuminate, base broadly cuneate, 15–31.5 by 7.5–18 cm, green above, pale below, glabrous with hairs on either side of the prominent midrib. Inflorescence profusely branched, lax, terminal on an aerial branch, composed of up to 10 major branches, each subtended by ca 3.5–6.5 cm long brown, papery bract and bearing a bicarinate prophyll, 2–6 cm long, just above its base; distal internode of the inflorescence branch elongate, 1.6–1.8 cm long; each node with a brown, papery, curled bract forming a tube, ca 3 cm long, subtending either a prophyllate branch or a special paraclade with 1 flower-pair; primary axis of the flower-pairs 2.6–3.5 cm long; pedicel of individual flowers 1.5–4.0 mm long, associated bracteole persistent, ca 2 mm long, fleshy. Flower 1.5–2.5 cm long, white; sepals 3, free, narrow, acute, ca 3.2 by 0.7 mm, white; petal lobes oblong, acute, ca 1.2 by 0.3 cm, white; corolla tube ca 6.8 mm long; staminodal tube ca 5 mm longer than corolla tube; outer staminodes 2, petaloid lobes emarginate, unequal in size, the larger one obovate, ca 9.4 by 6.2 mm, the smaller one oblanceolate, ca 9.0 by 3.2 mm, white; cucullate staminode oblong, with free part of ca 4.3 by 2.4 mm, with a ca 2 mm long appendage, white with yellow tip; callose staminode obovate with free part of ca 6.8 by 6.2 mm, white with pale yellow tip; fertile stamen ca 1.5 mm long, appendage linear, ca 3 mm long; style with free part of ca 5.6 mm, curved; ovary ca 1.8 mm, pubescent. Fruits globose or subglobose, ca 1.3 cm in diam., greenish or white, with scattered fine hairs. Seeds 1–3 (usually 2), broadly elliptic, ca 7.0 by 6.2 mm, aril small, without appendage.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Donax canniformis. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 125. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Rhizomatous ground herb, 50–150 cm high, usually with many conspicuous stolons, these slender, 2–4 mm in diam., with small bracts at the nodes, ca 3 mm in diam.; roots sometimes with 1–5 globular tubers, up to 2.5 cm in diam. Leaves 3–6 per shoot; sheath 8–75 cm long, light green, with scattered white hairs especially along margin; petiole 5–52.5 cm long, light green, nearly glabrous; pulvinus (1.0–)2.2–2.5 cm long, brownish-green, glabrous; lamina oblong to oblong-elliptic (14.0) 18.4–31.5 by (5.7) 8.3–12.7 cm, light to dark green above, whitish-green and glaucous below, glabrescent. Inflorescence interfoliar, erect, appearing to protrude from the sheath of an accompanying leaf but usually enclosed by the leaf sheath; peduncle 6–53 cm long, with scattered white hairs; synflorescence consisting of 2–5 simple, erect spikes, 16–31 by 0.8–1.0 cm, sessile or with a short peduncle, to 4 cm long; fertile bracts narrowly lanceolate, acute, 6–14 per spike, distichously arranged; the first bract 6–15 by 1.0–1.4 cm, the remaining progressively diminishing in size, to 3.4–4.5 by 0.5 cm in the distal part of the spike, light green, nearly glabrous; flower-pair 1 per special paraclade, associated prophyll 2.3–4.5 by 0.2–0.5 cm. Flowers white, 2.5–3.2 cm across; sepals 3, unequal, the dorsal one small, ovate, ca 2.5 by 1.8 mm, with the base swollen to form a short spur, minutely hairy, the two 2 lateral; sepals larger, lanceolate, acute, 8–10 by 3 mm, whitish, translucent, with many reddish-brown tinges near their apex; petal lobes oblong, apex round, ca 12 by 4 mm, whitish; corolla tube very short; staminodal tube ca 3 mm longer than corolla tube; outer staminode 2, subequal, petaloid lobes obovate, apex round, clawed, 1.2–1.5 by 1.0–1.1 cm; cucullate staminode oblong, with free part of ca 2.6 by 1.3 mm; callose staminode obovate ca 10.0 by 6.7 mm, whitish, with yellow tip; fertile stamen ca 1.3 mm long, petaloid appendage large, subrhombic, clawed, ca 10 by 7.7 mm; style with free part ca 7.6 mm long, curved; ovary ca 1.3 mm long, covered with scattered minute hairs. Fruits cylindrical-ellipsoid, 8–10 by 4 mm. Seed 1, oblong, ca 7.6 by 3.7 mm, aril with 2 very short appendages.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Halopegia blumei. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 126. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Up to 5 m high. Leaves with long petiole; blade oblong, glabrous, up to 1.2 m long, 40 cm broad. Inflorescence erect, up to 60 cm long, 30 cm broad, axis glabrous, straight, reddish to yellowish; bracts large, broad, boat-shaped, surrounding the peduncle, red, with yellowish apex. Flowers yellowish or greenish. Fruit ca 10 by 7 cm.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Heliconia bihai. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 111. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Up to 1 m high. Leaves with long petiole; blade linear lanceolate, with rounded base, up to 30–45 by 3–5 cm. Inflorescence erect, 6–8 cm long, with somewhat flexious axis; bracts 4–5, narrowly lanceolate, not deeply boat-shaped, ca 8 cm long, red or yellow. Flowers greenish, yellowish or red.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Heliconia psittacorum. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 112. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Up to 5 m high, pseudostem 1–2 m. Leaves with long petiole; blade oblong, acute with subcordate base, glabrous, up to 200 cm long, 40 cm broad. Inflorescence pendulous, ca 30 cm long, 15–17 cm broad, with the axis red, zigzag, more or less pubescent; bracts large, broad, boat-shaped, surrounding the peduncle, red with yellowish-green margin and yellow apex. Flowers pale to bright yellow; staminode spathulate, convex.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Heliconia rostrata. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 112. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Leaves linear in a basal rosette, 40–90 cm long, ca 1 cm broad. Stem leafless as long as the leaves or slightly longer with about 8–12 fragrant flowers. Perianth 10–25 cm long, bright yellow, basally joined in a tube, ca 2 cm long. Filaments ca 5 cm; anthers yellow, ca 1 cm. Capsule ellipsoid, 3–4 cm long. Seeds shining black, ovoid, 5–6 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Hemerocallis lilioasphodelus. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 116. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Tufted herbs with swollen, tuberous roots. Leaves basal, glaucous, narrowly sword shaped, 10–25 by 3–7 cm in flowering stage, later enlarging up to 35 cm length; base of stem surrounded by brownish fibres from old leaf bases. Flowering stem 2–8 cm; spathes 3, green, lanceolate, 2–5 cm, 2–4 flowered. Flowers bluish violet, 2–5 cm in diam. Perianth tube 3–5 cm; outer segments elliptic-ovate, 2.5–3 cm, spreading; crest orange, undulate; inner segments erect, oblanceolate, 2–3 cm long. Stamens ca 1.5 cm; anthers yellow. Style branches ca 2 cm long. Capsule ovoid, 1.5–2.5 by ca 1.5 cm, terminated by a short beak. Seeds dark brown, arillate.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Iris collettii. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 117. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Evergreen shrub to tree, up to 12 m high, dbh up to 26 cm. Bark thin, somewhat pustular-lenticellate, grey to white, soon changing to orange or brown after cutting; inner bark pink; wood light yellowish, after long time orange. Branches hairy when young. Leaves simple; petiole 0.8–4.3 cm long, flat and slightly winged at the edges above, basally pulvinate, usually slightly hairy; blade elliptic to obovate, 6.2–40 by 1.4–14 cm, length/width ratio 2.7–5, symmetric, (sub)coriaceous, base usually long attenuate, margin entire to laxly spinously serrate in mainly upper half, apex acuminate (to cuspidate), upper surface glabrous to hairy on the midrib and sometimes the major nerves, glossy dark green, lower surface green, slightly hairy along major venation to hairy, small pocket-like domatia usually present, usually with hairs; nerves 16–24, sometimes slightly tinged red. Inflorescences erect, up to 42 cm long, sericeous, basal side branches subtended by leaves. Flowers white (to yellowish), pleasantly fragrant; pedicels absent (to up to 3 mm long); sepals 5 or 6 (6th empty bract), hairy along margin to slightly hairy outside too, white; outer sepals/bracts: 1 or 2 slightly below flower, ovate to elliptic, 0.6–1.2 by 0.5–0.6 mm, the one touching the flower ovate, 0.9–1.2 by 0.6–0.9 mm; inner sepals ovate, 1–1.3 by 1.1–1.3 mm; outer petals ovate, 1.6–1.8 by 1.9–2.2 mm, thin, apex rather acute, folded somewhat inwardly, glabrous, white, inner petals ca 1 mm high, split till halfway, glabrous to ciliolate apically, never with a central lobule; filaments 0.5–0.8 mm long, glabrous, white; anthers orange; pollen yellow; ovary ca 0.4 by 0.5 mm, glabrous; stigma 0.5–0.6 mm long. Fruits 5–7 by 4.2–6.5 by 4.2–5.2 mm, symmetric to basally oblique, (indistinctly) areolate, ridged, glabrous, green ripening black.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Meliosma simplicifolia. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 162. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Leaf blade elliptic to obovate, margin entire to usually laxly serrate in especially the upper half; midrib above densely hairy; lower surface hirsute all over, thairy pocket domatia usually present in all nerve axils. Mature buds 1.5–2 mm in diam. Fruits 4.5–8 mm in diam., usually basally oblique, keel usually distinct.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Meliosma simplicifolia fruticosa. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 165. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Rhizomotous ground herb, 2–2.5 m high. Leaves 4–6 per shoot; sheath 50–75 cm long, green, with long setose hairs at the margin; petiole 15–64 cm long, green, glabrous or pubescent on the lower part; pulvinus 3.0–3.5 cm long; lamina narrowly oblong, 28–55 by 7.5–11.5 cm, acuminate with a 2–3 cm long projection at the apex. Inflorescence interfoliar, erect, appearing to protrude from the sheath of an accompanying leaf; peduncle 45–60 cm long, green, pubescent; synflorescence congested, 7–8 cm in diam., first order branches 2–5, up to 4 cm long, spirally arranged; fertile bracts 16 per branch, spirally arranged, elliptic to ovate, 1.7–5.5 by 0.9–2.0 cm, greenish-white, glabrous, soon becoming dry and withering into a mesh of many long fine fibres; flower-pairs 2–3 per special paraclade, associated prophylls 13–17 by 7.5–10 mm, interphylls ca 9.5 by 3.2 mm. Flowers white, 1.8–2.1 cm long; sepal 3, free, linear, ca 12 by 2 mm, glabrous, translucent; petal lobes oblong, ca 11.2 by 2.6 mm, rounded at apex, white; corolla tube very short, infundibuliform ca 2 mm long; staminodal tube 3–4 mm longer than corolla tube; outer staminodes 2, smaller than the petal lobes, with petaloid lobe obovate, 5–6 by 2.4 mm, white; cucullate staminode oblong, with free part of ca 5.3 by 2.0 mm, white, and appendage ca 2 mm long; callose staminode obovate, with free part of ca 7.5 by 5.0 mm, white; fertile stamen ca 2 mm long, with a petaloid appendage of 1.2 mm; style with free part of ca 6.8 mm, curved; ovary 3 mm long, densely hairy. Fruits obpyramidal, ca 1.2 by 1.2 cm, white, covered with sparsely short hairs. Seeds 3, triangular, ca 6.2 by 4.8 mm, aril very small, indistinct.
creator: Rachun Pooma
bibliographicCitation: Phrynium hainanense. Flora of Thailand. Vol. 9. Part 2, 2008. Pg. 129. Accessed 2021-07-31

description: Rhizomatous ground herb, to 1.8 m high. Leaves 6–7 per shoot; sheath 49–84 cm long, green with brown hairs; petiole 21–58 cm long, green, hairy, becoming glabrous when old; pulvinus 4–6 cm long, greenish-brown, hairy or glabrous; lamina 30–50 by 11–14 cm, green above, green to purplish-red below, glabrous or slightly hairy along midvein. Inflorescence interfoliar, erect, apparently protruding from the petiole of the accompanying leaf; peduncle 41–125 cm long; synflorescence capitate, densely congested, 3–6 cm in diam., made up by 3–4 branches of several orders, each 2–3 cm long; bracts subtending the proximal branches large, ca 6 by 3 cm, hairy, partly enclosing the entire synflorescence; fertile bracts spirally positioned, 2–3 by 1.0–1.5 cm, brown, hairy, becoming shredded and fibrous with age; flower-pairs 2–3 per special paraclade. description: Rhizomatous ground herb, 1.5–3.5 m high. Leaves 2–3 per shoot; sheath 40–65 cm long, reddish-green to brownish, glabrous; petiole 70–172 cm long, green, glabrous, pulvinus 3–12 cm, brownish-green to dark green, glabrous; lamina ovate to ovate-oblong, acuminate, 27–76 by 13.4–34.0 cm, green to dark green above, pale below, with purplish-red margin, glabrous. description: Rhizomatous ground herb, up to 2 m high. description: Rhizomatous ground herb, 1–2 m high. description: Rhizomatous ground herb, 1–3 m high. description: Liana to 30 m high, to 11 cm in diam. Bark greyish-brown, shallowly and irregularly longitudinally fissured. Twigs terete, climbing by means of (opposite) axillary twigs 15–30 cm long, which hook for 180°–360° around supports; younger parts densely brown stellate hairy, hairs of mixed sizes. Leaves caducous; petiole 0.7–1.2 cm long; blade (ob) ovate, orbicular or elliptic 8–15(–20) by 4–6(–9) cm, base shallowly cordate, rounded, or subcuneate, apex acute acuminate, margin entire, adaxial surface (except nerves) glabrescent; nerves pinnate, in 4–6 pairs, the lowest, basal ones, weaker, adaxially flat. Inflorescences axillary to upper leaves, paniculate-thyrsiform, 4–11 cm long including the 2–6 cm long peduncle, bracteate, flowers in many-flowered subglobose clusters, densely hairy. Flowers white, fragrant; pedicel (2–)3 mm long. Calyx lobes 3(–4), free, apert, oblong, ca 1 mm long. Corolla sympetalous in bud urceolate, ± inflated, somewhat fleshy, ca 3 by 2 mm, densely brown hairy outside, more sparsely so inside, at apex with 3 (or 4) free valvate triangular lobes, ca 0.5 mm long, the tube at anthesis tearing apart into 3 (or 4) oblong, recurved, secondarily formed free petals 3.5–4 mm long, remaining connate at base for only ca 0.2 mm. Stamens 40(–50), free, in ±2 rows; filaments slender, terete, white, at apex slightly clavate, 2.5–4 mm long; anthers broadly clavate, somewhat flattened, (0.3–)0.4 mm long. Ovary broadly ovoid-globose, faintly 3-grooved, ca 0.8 mm long, densely brown hairy (hairs stellate, but arms long and patent); style glabrous, 1.5–2 mm long; stigma minute, faintly 3-lobed, papillate. Fruit one or few developing per infructescence, 3-winged, with reflexed perianth and persistent stamens, woody, indehiscent, green then brown, 1 seed in one of the locules, the other 2 locules remaining empty; fruiting pedicel 5–10 mm long, fruit except wings ± turbinate, 6–11 by 5–10 mm, apex flattish with minute remnant of style, hairy; fruit including wings 4–8 cm wide; wings spreading, each one growing from below the apex of the fruit, corresponding with the locules, coriaceous, elliptic oblong, 2–3.5(–5) cm long, somewhat narrowed at base, apex rounded, 7–8 parallel-nerved, more sparsely hairy. Seed elliptic-oblong, subterete, at apex curved into the hollow extension of the locule towards the wing-base, 10–12 by 4(–6) mm, brownish-black, very finely irregularly striate; albumen white.

description: Annual herb lacking a basal rosette of leaves when flowering, 8–20(–40) cm high; upper parts covered in short hairs and sparsely or densely glandular. description: Annual, usually erect herb, 30(–50) cm high, lacking a basal rosette of leaves when flowering; upper parts minutely papillose, sparsely and shortly hirsute. description: Perennial herb, 5–20 cm high, with a single basal rosette of leaves, rosette present on flowering. Bracts ± ovate to triangular, much smaller than the flowers, sometimes largely green other-times mostly membranous with a green midrib. Flowers in long spikes 5–15(–20) cm long; the lower often well-separated from each other the upper usually congested. Outer tepals free, yellowish, equal or nearly so, up to 20 cm long; 2 inner ones also equal in shape and similar to the outer ones, the posterior one smaller, 8–10 cm long. description: Woody climber or scandent shrub, evergreen, glabrous (Thailand). Leaves: petiole up to 1.7 cm long; blade ovate to elliptic, oblong, 3–12(–15) by 1–5 cm, length/width ratio 2–4.5, pergamentaceous, symmetric, base rounded to acute, attenuate, apex acuminate to cuspidate, slightly mucronate; nerves 5–10 per side. description: Widely branched plant, up to 2.5 m high. Sheath 5.3–12.5 cm long; pulvinus 0.4–1.0 cm long, green, glabrous; lamina elliptic to broadly elliptic 5.8–14.0 by 2.8–6.7 cm, glabrous, acute at the apex, broadly cuneate at the base, dark green above, pale below. description: Shrub up to 4 m. Stem glabrous, swollen above the nodes when young. Leaves elliptic to ovate, 25–50 by 13–25 cm, apex acute to acuminate, base attenuate, often oblique, glabrous on both sides but with minute sessile glands invisible to the naked eye; petiole 5–11 cm. Inflorescence terminal, sessile, dense, later becoming pseudolateral. Flowers heterodistylous 5-merous (rarely 4-merous). Calyx tube very short, lobes linear to band-shaped, 11–14 mm long, glabrous. Corolla yellow, often slightly zygomorphic, tube ca 18 mm long, 3 mm in diam., outside glabrous, inside sparsely hairy in upper part, lobes 5-angular, 4.5–5.5 mm long, outer surface glabrous, inner hairy. Stamens 2; filaments ca 2 mm long (thrum), 0.7 mm long (pin) long-inserted in the corolla tube; anthers 4.5–5 mm wide. Ovary obconical, ca 3 by 3 mm; style ca 6 mm long (thrum) and 9 mm (pin) long; stigma ca 3.5 mm (thrum) and ca 2.2 mm (pin) long. Fruit fleshy, white often with a purple tinge, depressed-ovate, 8–10 by 10–13 mm, with outward curving calyx lobes. Seeds black, long remaining on the central placenta.

description: Rhizomatous ground herb, 1.7–4 m high. Leaves 1–3 per shoot; sheath 35–55 cm long, green, glabrous, young leaves ± glaucous below; petiole 80–350 cm long, green, glabrous; pulvinus (3.0–)6.0–10.5 cm long, glabrous; lamina oblong to ovate-oblong, 39.3–83.0 by 19–43.5 cm, acuminate, dark green above, pale below, glabrous. Flowers white to creamy white, slightly fragrant, 3.8–4.6 cm long; sepals 3, free, narrowly lanceolate to ovate, sometimes with up to 4 short projections at the margin, 3.5–4.0 by 1.0–2.4 mm, white or brownish, translucent with many brownish fine spots; corolla tube 24–39 mm long; petal lobes oblong to broadly oblong, acute, 10–11 by 3.7–5.0 mm, greenish-brown to yellowish-brown, translucent, deflexed and curled; staminodal tube of the same length as the corolla tube; outer staminodes 2, subequal, petaloid lobes obovate to broadly obovate, 8.8–13.7 mm by 7.5–10.1 mm, white to creamy white; cucullate staminode oblong, with free part of 3.7–6.3 by 2.0–2.4 mm, tip light yellow, appendage 0.5–1.0 mm; callose staminode with free part of 3.0–6.2 by 2.5–3.5 mm; fertile stamen 1.2–2.0 mm long, with a hood like appendage of 2.5–6.3 by 2.0–2.3 mm; style with free part of 5.0–7.5 mm long, hooked; ovary 2.7–3.2 mm long, glabrous to densely hairy. Fruits broadly ellipsoid, compressed at both sides, ca 13.7 by 12.4 mm, pale brown, glabrous. Seeds 1–2, oblong, rugose, ca 12.5 by 5.6 mm; aril large, ca 5 mm in diam., with 2 appendages, 5–6 mm long.

description: Rhizomatous ground herb, 1–2 m high. Leaves 3–4 per shoot; sheath 10–55 cm long, green, nearly glabrous to densely hairy; petiole 31–78 cm long, green, with a similar indumentum; pulvinus 2–2.5 cm long; lamina ovate to oblong 19–55 by 10–33 cm, abruptly acuminate into a constricted apex, acumen 2.0–2.6 cm long, upper leaf surface uniformly green, glabrous, lower surface pale green, glabrous to densely hairy. Inflorescence interfoliar, erect, sometimes appearing to protrude from the sheath of an accompanying leaf; peduncle 6–45 cm long, glabrous or hairy, green; synflorescence markedly elongate, 7–17 cm long; first order branches 0–3, erect, distichously arranged, 5.5–11.5 cm long, simple or the basal rarely with one short second order branch; fertile bracts (9–)14–22 per branch, distichously arranged, ovate, acute, 2–4 cm long and 0.6–2 cm wide, green, glabrous or hairy; flower-pairs 1–3 per special paraclade, associated prophylls 15–17 by 7–8.5 mm, interphyll 11–15 by 4–7.5 mm. Flowers white, slightly fragrant, ca 3.4 cm long; sepals 3, free, narrowly lanceolate, 3–4 by 0.7 mm, greenish or brownish-white, with brown tip; corolla tube ca 19.5 mm long; petal lobes broadly oblong, acute, ca 8.5 by 3.2 mm, greenish, translucent, deflexed and curled; staminodial tube ca 2.5 mm longer than the corolla tube; outer staminodes 2, subequal, the large one broadly obovate, white, with a free part of ca 3.7 by 3.2 mm; cucullate staminode subtriangulate, white with yellow apex, the free part ca 4.5 by 4.7 mm, with a minute appendage, ca 1 mm long; callose staminode obovate, white, with a free part of ca 3.7 by 3.2 mm; fertile stamen ca 1.6 mm long, with a hood-like appendage of ca 3.5 by 2 mm; style with a free part ca 8 mm long, hooked; ovary ca 2.7 mm long, densely hairy. Young fruits ellipsoid, hairy. Seed 1, arillate, the aril with two appendages.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Rhizomatous ground herb, 1–2 m high. Leaves 1–3 per shoot; sheath 35–45 cm long, green, glabrous; petiole 36–71 cm long, green, glabrous to sparsely hairy; pulvinus 2.5–7.5 cm long, dark green, glabrous; lamina ovate-oblong 32–67 by 9.6–22.7 cm, acuminate, green, glabrous to sparsely hairy. Inflorescence interfoliar, erect, sometimes appearing to protrude from the petiole of the accompanying leaf, peduncle 73–110 cm long, green, glabrous to sparsely hairy; synflorescence capitate, 4–8(–10) cm in diam., made up by 6 or more branches of up to several orders, these densely congested, 2.5–3.5 by 1.0–1.5 cm; bracts subtending the proximal branches enlarged, ovate to elliptic, stiff, acuminate, with a sharp spine-tip, 2.1–2.5 by 0.8–2.4 cm, light green with creamy white margin; fertile bracts ovate-elliptic to lanceolate, spirally or distichously arranged, light green with creamy white margin, 2–2.5 by 0.5–1 cm, stiff with a sharp spine-tip; flower-pairs 2–3 per special paraclade, associated prophylls 22–25 by 5 mm, interphylls 22–25 by 8.7 mm. Flowers orange white, ca 2.5–2.7 cm long; sepals 3, free, subequal, linear, ca 2.5–6.2 mm long, white with many purplish-red spots; petal lobes elliptic, acute, ca 6.2 by 2.6 mm, white translucent, deflexed and curled; corolla tube ca 1.7 cm long; staminodal tube ca 6 mm longer than corolla tube; outer staminodes 2, unequal, orange, the larger one broadly obovate, ca 6.5 by 5.2 mm, the smaller one narrower, ca 6.5 by 3 mm; cucullate staminode with unequally lobed margin, pale orange; fertile stamen ca 1 mm long, with a narrow appendage of ca 2.4 by 0.5 mm; style with free part of ca 1.5 mm, hooked; ovary 2 mm long, almost glabrous except for minute hairs in the upper part. Fruits cylindrical, ca 1.2 by 0.5 cm. Seed 1, ca 10.1 by 3 mm, exposed when mature, shining bluish-gray, with a thick, orange or red aril, ca 2 by 3 mm, aril with milky sap.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Rhizomatous ground herb, 38.0–52.5 cm high. Leaves 1–3 per shoot; sheath 6.0–9.8 cm long, green, glabrous to pubescent; petiole 7.7–21.2 cm long, green, glabrous to pubescent; pulvinus 7–12 mm long, densely hairy on upper surface, glabrous to pubescent below, light green; lamina elliptic to oblong, acute to acuminate, 10.3–17 by 3.4–5.4 cm, green to dark green above, with ± short oblique bars of darker green, pale below, glabrous to pubescent. Inflorescence interfoliar, erect, usually simple; peduncle 5–14 cm long; main inflorescence axis 2.7–7.5 cm long; fertile bracts 3–6, distichous, narrowly ovate to narrowly lanceolate, acute, apiculate, 12–20 by 4–9 mm, light green to yellowish-green, glabrous; flower-pairs 2 per special paraclade (usually only 1 pair developed), associated prophylls 9.5–16.0 by 4.0–6.5 mm, interphylls very small, ca 1 mm in diam. Flowers white, 10.5–11.0 cm long; sepals 3, free, small, subequal, 1.2–2.5 by 0.3 mm, white; corolla tube 13.7–18.0 mm long; petal lobes elliptic to oblong, acute, 5.8–6.2 by 1.8–2.7 mm, whitish, translucent, deflexed and curled; staminodal tube ca 0.5 mm longer than corolla tube; outer staminodes 2, subequal, petaloid lobes elliptic to obovate, 7.3–8.0 by 2.8–3.7 mm, white; cucullate staminode with free part of 2.7–3.0 by 1.0– 1.4 mm, tip yellow, appendage very small; callose staminode with free part of 2.6–3.7 by 1.2–2.3 mm, white; fertile stamen 1.0–1.3 mm long, with a small hood-like appendage; style with free part of 3.7–4.8 mm, curved, hooked; ovary 2.5–2.7 mm, glabrous or hairy in upper part. Fruits broadly ellipsoid to obovate, 3.8 by 3.8–5.2 mm. Seeds 1–2, oblong, ca 12.5 by 5.6 mm, rugose; aril large, with 2 appendages, 4–5 mm long.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Rhizomatous ground herb, 64–150 cm high. Leaves 1–3 per shoot; sheath 15–40 cm long, green, glabrous; petiole (5–)21–82 cm long, green, glabrous; pulvinus 0.4–3.5 cm long, greenish or whitish-green, glabrous; lamina narrowly oblong to ovate-oblong, rarely ovate, acute to acuminate, 9.6–46.0 by 2.0–15.3 cm, dark green to light green above, pale below, glabrous. Inflorescence interfoliar, erect, often appearing to protrude from the sheath of an accompanying leaf, simple or with 2–3(–5) shorter first order branches; peduncle 1–35 cm long; main inflorescence axis ca 4–10.7 cm long; fertile bracts 6–9, distichous to subspirally arranged, ovate to narrowly lanceolate, 1.2–3.5 by 0.4–2.2 cm, acute, apiculate, light green; flower-pairs 2–3 per special paraclade, associated prophylls 6.8–19.0 by 3.5–10.0 mm, interphylls small, 2–4 by 0.5–2.3 mm. Flowers white, 3.5–4.5 cm long; sepals 3, free, linear, ca 3–3.2 by 0.6–0.7 mm, white to creamy white, with scattered reddish-brown spots; corolla tube ca 2.1–3.0 cm long; petal lobes elliptic-oblong to oblong, acute, ca 8.2–8.7 by 2.6–3.5 mm, white to pinkish- white, translucent, deflexed and curled; staminodal tube slightly longer than the corolla tube; outer staminodes 2, subequal, their petaloid lobes elliptic to obovate or broadly obovate, rounded at apex, 10.0–12.5 by 4.6–11.3 mm, white; cucullate staminode with free part of 4–5 by 1.4–1.7 mm, bright yellow or white with yellow tip, appendage small, ca 0.8 mm; callose staminode subrhombic, with free part of 3.8–4.2 by 2.7–3.7 mm, yellowish-brown; fertile stamen 1.0–1.3 mm long, with a hood-like appendage ± same size as that of the cucullate staminode; style with free part of 4–7 cm, curved; ovary ca 2.5 mm long, glabrous or with minute hairs in the upper part. Fruits broadly ellipsoid to narrowly obovate, 12–14 by 7–8 mm. Seed 1, broadly ellipsoid, ca 7 by 3.8 mm, rugose; aril large, with 2 long appendages of ca 8 mm.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Stout, rhizomatous herb up to about 1 m. Leaf blade ovate-oblong, 50–60 cm long. Inflorescence pedunculate from the centre of the leafy shoot about the same height as the leaves, ending in a coarse, boat-formed, spathaceous bract, green outside orange inside; upper part of peduncle often also yellowish-orange. Flowers overall yellowish-orange, or pure yellow in some cultivars, with the sagittate structure dark violet.

description: Herb with short, stout rhizome and thin, fibrous roots. Leaves numerous, tufted, filiform, glabrous, 15–30 cm long. Peduncle as long as leaves, unbranched, terminated by an umbellate inflorescence with up to 10 blue flowers. Bracts membranous, lanceolate, 3–4 mm long. Pedicels 1–2 cm, articulated near base. Perianth segments entire, oblong, 7–8 by 1–2 mm, outer ones with scarious margin, inner ones with fringed margin. Stamens about half as long as perianth; outer anthers ca 1 mm, inner ones ca 2 mm. Capsule ellipsoid, ca 4 by 3 mm. Seeds globose, ca 1 mm in diam.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Trees, up to 30 m high, dbh up to 40 cm; buttresses sometimes present or slightly fluted. Outer bark smooth to lenticellate to rough, whitish to grey to dark brown, ca 1 mm thick; inner bark 3–10 mm thick, granular to fibrous, cream to yellow to orange-brown to light brownish; wood yellowish to light brown, hard, heartwood pale salmon pink. Stipules 7.5–13 by 1–2 mm. Leaves: petiole 5–7 mm long, hairy to glabrous; blade 8–18 by 2.6–6 cm, length/width ratio 2.3–2.7, base cuneate, upper surface dark green with lighter veins, sparsely hairy when young; lower surface light green with silvery to glaucous; nerves 5–8 per side. Inflorescences up to 40 cm long, hairy. Pedicels ca 8 mm long, hairy. Sepals ovate, 2.5–3 by 1.5-1.9 mm, acute, hairy, yellowish-green. Petals white with yellow to orange honeymark inside; flag-like petal with pouch ca 2 by 3 mm, apical, reflexed part ca 1.5 mm long; lateral petals 3.5-4.5 by 1.3–2 mm; keel-like petals 4–5 by ca 2 mm. Stamens: tube ca 1 mm long; free filament part 0.3–0.5 mm; anthers 0.3–0.5 mm long. Pistil: ovary ca 0.5 mm high; style 1.2–1.5 mm long. Fruits yellow to reddish-yellow, ca 6 cm high by 7 cm wide, single samaras 5–5.5 by 2–2.2 cm, basal third containing seed. Seeds (Ng, 1972) single per samara, obovate, flat, ca 1.8 by 0.5 by 0.1 cm.
creator: Rachun Pooma

description: Robust perennial. Stems terete, 1.5–3 m by 0.4–0.7 cm. Leaves 52–120 cm by 4–12 mm, convex on abaxial side, transverse section semicircular. Spike: staminate part 8–40 cm by 2–7 mm, with 1–3 deciduous bracts; pistillate part (5–)15–30 by 0.6–2 cm, mid-to dark brown, cushion-like when mature, separated from staminate part by a sterile axis 2.5–7 cm long; stamens 3, rarely 2 or 4; anthers 1.5–2 mm long; female flowers with bracteoles; bracteoles filiform, whitish; ovary fusiform; stalk slender, ca 5 mm long; styles 1–1.5 mm long; stigmas linear to lanceolate, 1.3–1.8 mm long; hairs on stalk shorter than style. Fruit long-elliptic.

description: Small to large tree, to 6 m high (in Thailand), elsewhere to 25(–40) m, without buttresses. Leaves imparipinnate with 3–5 pairs of lateral leaflets (in Thailand), elsewhere (0–)1–8 pairs; leaflets chartaceous (to subcoriaceous elsewhere), margins crenate; in Thailand, intervenium glabrous on both sides, midrib prominent and shortly pubescent on underside; lateral leaflets ± sessile, lanceolate to ovate, the largest per leaf ca 4–6 by 1.3–1.8 cm locally (overall range 2.2–12 by 0.8–4.5 cm), the base sometimes unequal and the apex acute to acuminate; terminal leaflets petiolulate, narrowly elliptic to narrowly ovate, 5.5–7 by 1.7–2.3 cm locally (overall range 2.5–10 by 1–3.3 cm); young leaves often bright red. Stipules usually orbicular, subreniform or broadly spathulate, 8–15 by 8–18 mm. Inflorescence 1 or 2 (–3) opposite pairs of lateral dyads or tetrads; peduncles 3–18 mm; racemes 7.5–15 cm; axes pubescent. Flowers unisexual or hermaphroditic, cream to pale pink; pedicels 1.5–3 mm long, minutely hairy. Calyx lobes 0.6–0.9 mm, hairy at base. Petals oblong to obovate, 1–2 by 0.7–1.2 mm. Disc lobes oblong, 0.2–0.5 mm long; ovary densely pubescent. Male flowers: filaments to 3 mm; ovary ca 0.5 mm; styles ca 0.1 mm, incurved. Female flowers: filaments 0.6–1.2 mm; ovary 0.6–1.2 mm; styles 1–1.3 mm long, initially incurved and eventually straight. Bisexual flowers: filaments 3–3.5 mm long; ovary 0.6–0.8 mm; styles 1.5–2 mm, eventually straight. Capsules with valves 2–4(–6) by 1.5–2(–3) mm at dehiscence; exocarp reddish when immature, turning brown, pubescent; calyx lobes often persistent. Seeds ca 0.8 mm long, comose at both ends, the hairs to 2 mm long, brown.
creator: Rachun Pooma
